bug.title: A panel member's recorded vote disappears from the appeal card after a reload
bug.symptoms: okafor votes Uphold on an appeal panel and sees "You voted to uphold the decision on 18 Nov 2026"; after reloading /mod the card shows the blank vote form again ("Choose an outcome...", empty reasons, "Cast my vote") although the server holds the vote (his attention item is gone, his notice says he voted) appeals.ts parses viewer_vote into viewerVote, but appeal-card.tsx does not pass it to AppealVoteForm, whose "recorded" state lives only in component state; the appeal detail returns no date for the viewer's vote
bug.expected: The appeal detail returns the viewer's vote and when it was cast (viewer_vote, viewer_voted_at) to a seated member; the card passes them to the vote form, which opens in its recorded state "You voted to uphold/overturn the decision on {date}. {n} of 3 members have voted." with "Change my vote" while the panel is undecided (read-only once decided); a member who has not voted sees the blank form; tests cover a reload with an existing vote, no vote, and a decided panel
bug.actual: A member is invited to vote again with no sign of the vote already cast
